SELECT ledger.id, ledger.occurred_at, student.student_name, ledger.change_type, ledger.amount, ledger.available_delta, ledger.source_type, organization.organization_name AS source_organization_name, task.title AS task_title, reviewer.display_name AS reviewer_name, ledger.remark FROM growth_point_ledger ledger JOIN edu_student student ON student.id = ledger.student_id LEFT JOIN sys_organization organization ON organization.id = ledger.source_organization_id LEFT JOIN learn_task task ON task.id = ledger.source_task_id LEFT JOIN sys_user reviewer ON reviewer.id = ledger.reviewer_user_id
AND ledger.id > #{cursor} AND ledger.id <= #{upperBound} ORDER BY ledger.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
